title: Bug found on Libre news
body:
#### Expected behavior While changing the server and then pressing on the refresh button the app should refresh the news flashes as expected. Or should work normally as it does on the given server. #### Actual behavior While I changed the server to get different news flashes and then pressed the refresh button, the app crashed again and again. #### How to reproduce Open the app. Click on the server option. Change the server. Now press the refresh button. The app crashes. * Browser: Libre News * Operating system: Android Nought(7) Moto g5 plus #### Recording Of The Bug https://youtu.be/9Lf84UArX8Q
Posted on Utopian.io - Rewarding Open Source Contributors

comments.body: Interesting. Because `Steemit.com` is not a LibreNews server, you won't be able to receive notifications from it—that being said, this is indeed a bug. The connection icon should go red; the app shouldn't crash.
